references.text: The pillar of cloud that led the people of Israel through the wilderness, the same divine presence that appeared at the entrance of the tent
The immediate context describing the tent of meeting outside the camp where Moses met with the Lord
The Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend - clarifying how God spoke with Moses
The cloud covered the tent of meeting and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle, parallel to the presence of the pillar of cloud
The Lord came down in the cloud and spoke to Moses, the same pattern with the cloud as a sign of divine communication
The Lord came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent, an almost identical description
The Lord appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the entrance of the tent
God spoke to them in the pillar of cloud, referring to Moses and Aaron's communication with God
Complements the entrance with the exit to show the wholeness of prophetic communication.
Clarifies the dynamics of God's presence by contrasting speech from the entrance and from the mercy seat.
Highlights the public dimension of God's presence at the tent.
Confirms the general location of God's speaking to Moses.
A prophetic precursor that explains the purpose of God's speaking in the cloud.
